safety_verdicts.content: Patient developed lower abdominal/suprapubic pain 2 days ago with a gradual onset.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts capture lower abdominal pain and a 2-day duration, but do not document the key qualifier that onset was gradual (vs sudden).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the pain onset was gradual (vs sudden) can weaken assessment of acute surgical/emergent causes (e.g., appendicitis, ruptured cyst), and may reduce the clarity of triage/diagnostic urgency. However, the record still captures key elements (location, duration, worsening), so downstream clinical impact is usually limited.
